_README: Single source of truth for API test data. Edit values here, then run `npm run build:postman` to regenerate the Postman collection. The Playwright tests read this file directly, so both tools always use the same data. The special value {{timestamp}} is replaced at runtime: Playwright uses Date.now(), Postman uses its built-in {{$timestamp}} dynamic variable.

mockapi._note: MockAPI stores JSON only, not binary files. 'Image upload' is modelled as a JSON record whose imageDataBase64 holds a data: URL string. 'Products' is a catalog used to exercise MockAPI's free-tier query params. VERIFIED LIVE: search (200 w/ match, 404 on no-match), sortBy+order, page, and limit all work. The legacy `filter=field:value` operator 404s (paid-plan feature on this workspace), and the bracketed `filter[field]=value` form returns 200 but is silently ignored (never filters). Field names use snake_case `in_stock` to match MockAPI's auto-generated schema field exactly.
